title: Back to Classic
notes: Ring combat removed again: fights work like before. Press SPACE to strike as often as you like.
Skills no longer fire on their own. Press 1 / 2 / 3 and R (or tap them). The hint tells you when a skill is ready.
New AUTO FARM button (top right): turn it on and skills and the ultimate fire automatically for easy farming, turn it off to fight yourself.
Kept from 0.14.0: Legion companions grow with your hero, and new characters start with their weapon and armor.
